lead: 371 interruptions across 3,180 km of line. Storms were the largest single cause, so the renewal programme starts with the overhead lines.
caption: Interruptions on the Larkfield Energy network by cause, 2026
note: Source: Larkfield Energy network report 2026, table 2.3. Planned works announced in advance are not included. Entered from the printed report on 31 March 2027.

rows.title: Storm damage
rows.text: 38 % of all interruptions, 104 of them during the February and November storms.

rows.title: Cable faults
rows.text: 30 %, almost all in cable laid before 1975.

rows.title: Third-party excavation
rows.text: 17 %, 41 of them on sites where no line enquiry had been made.

rows.title: Other and unexplained
rows.text: 5 %, including four cases where the cause was never found.
